_source: DOMINION D16: the nine Charters (old Evil Mode Part 28, src/data/evilMode/charters.json) read as Dominion's established start (Part 0 §6.1 Q4). Made by tools/dominion/charters-to-json.py; the old house rules are not carried.
lockLine: Finish one Dominion run to open the Charters.
pickLine: Start established: a team with a name, money, a crew and an HQ. The rainy warehouse is always there too.

charters.name: Rocket
charters.question: What's a ledger for?

patron.name: Carrow
patron.note: The clerk who kept the books and was never once in the room.

opening: The Ledger's already open. Four thousand, one hundred and twelve names.
A note from Faye, in biro, on a paper napkin: "I copied these by hand. Which d'you want to start with?"
Carrow: "What's a ledger for?"

charters.name: Rocket's Return
charters.question: Who were they waiting for?

patron.name: Sabela
patron.note: Called the roll for three years to an empty chair.

opening: A hundred and fifty people, at roll call. Sabela reads every name. Then: "The Boss."
A silence. It's three years long. Sabela, to you, not unkindly: "...Present?"
Sabela: "Who were they waiting for?"

charters.name: The Joint Command
charters.question: Can a house be two colours?

patron.name: Ottoway
patron.note: Bunked with recruits and trained six cohorts for a flood.

opening: Two messages, an hour apart. The blue side: "Don't trust the Magma lot. They'd have dried the sea." The red: "Don't trust the Aqua lot. They'd have drowned the land."
Ottoway: "I've trained both. I'm on the side of whoever's turn it is to wash up."
Ottoway: "Can a house be two colours?"

charters.name: Galactic
charters.question: Has anybody asked?

patron.name: Wren Halvard
patron.note: The technician who took her helmet off.

opening: A clipboard. Saturn, who's stayed, because somebody had to hand over: "I'll need a title for you. For the log."
The Board's all green. Every job's on time. Nobody in Galactic ever asked.
Wren Halvard: "Has anybody asked?"

charters.name: Plasma
charters.question: What are we counting?

patron.name: Bronius
patron.note: A Vigil Knight who counted candles.

opening: Six hundred candles and three hundred people with their hands in their pockets.
Bronius: "I count. Six hundred, every night, for a king. What am I counting, under you?"
Bronius: "What are we counting?"

charters.name: Flare
charters.question: Who's the table for?

patron.name: Yarborough
patron.note: The concierge who laid the tables.

opening: Yarborough, with a tray: "Will there be a table, under the new management? I ask only to know how many to lay."
Yarborough: "Who's the table for?"

charters.name: The Two Boards
charters.question: Who's doing the cooking?

patron.name: Iolana
patron.note: Tupp's aunt, who cooked for Skull before Plumeria did.

opening: Two Boards. One's a glass wall with every figure in the right column. One's plywood, rained on, with a drawing of a Wimpod.
Plumeria, with a ladle: "Who's doin' the cookin'?"
Iolana: "Who's doing the cooking?"

charters.name: The Group
charters.question: Who signed for this?
opening: Eight subsidiaries, each a column. And one that's a single line with no name, and a very large number.
A coach in the car park, engine running, twenty people in pink and black with horns.
Mr. Pettigrew: "Who signed for this?"

charters.name: The Staff Room
charters.question: Where were the adults?

patron.name: Yusuf
patron.note: The retired caretaker who watched a team form.

opening: A timetable, pinned to the Board. Third period: Battle Studies. Teacher: —
Yusuf: "They've asked for you. It came under the door, on squared paper. I'd go. I'd take chalk."
Yusuf: "Where were the adults?"

turn.title: THE TURN
turn.text: You won. The League is yours, and it isn't enough. Carry on as a Boss: one Grunt, one warehouse, your ace turned back to where it started.
opening: The trophy is in a box under the bed. The money is in a bag by the door.
Rook is waiting outside the warehouse, in the rain. "They said you'd come. The Champion. Here."
You tell him to get the door. It's a start.
